summary: PowerBank Corp (formerly SolarBank Corp), a Canadian construction firm, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Management's Discussion and Analysis and unaudited financial statements for the nine months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital return activity. No deal terms are disclosed. The filing includes certifications and incorporation by reference into an F-10 registration statement. Investors should monitor for any future strategic updates.
